title: Kth Strongest

story.briefing: Not the strongest signal — the kth strongest. The network reserves that slot for a relay that has to be identified precisely.
story.success: Relay identified. The reserved slot is assigned.

description: Given an array of signal strengths and an integer k, return the kth largest strength, counting duplicates separately so that in [7, 7, 3] the second largest is 7. If k is less than 1 or greater than the number of strengths, return -1.
hints: Once the values are in order, the answer is at a fixed position. Getting them in order is the entire task.
Check k against the array length before you index anything, and remember that k counts from 1 while array indices count from 0.
Return -1 when k is below 1 or above the length. Otherwise sort a copy in decreasing order and return the value at index k minus 1.
